Executable-directory fallback in `parseconfig` (src/tool_parsecfg.c:251) tries .curlrc, _curlrc. Needs manual reading: src/tool_parsecfg.c parseconfig(): the full .curlrc / -K parsing (quoting, '-' for stdin, option:argument syntax); src/tool_findfile.c findfile(): the withoutdot/dotscore interplay (dotscore is cleared after the first withoutdot attempt)
